resources.string:
1. GENERAL
These terms govern orders of handmade jewellery placed through this application.

2. ORDER
The order is binding once the customer taps the Order button and the seller confirms it by e-mail.

3. PRICE AND PAYMENT
All prices are in Czech crowns including VAT. Payment is possible by bank transfer or cash on delivery.

4. ENGRAVED ITEMS
Engraved bracelets are made to the customer's wishes and therefore cannot be returned within the 14 day withdrawal period.

5. DELIVERY
The bracelet is usually shipped within 5 working days. Items with engraving may take up to 10 working days.

6. COMPLAINTS
Complaints are handled in accordance with the Czech Civil Code within 30 days of receipt.

7. PERSONAL DATA
Personal data are processed only for the purpose of fulfilling the order, in accordance with the GDPR.
